concept: launchd ExitTimeOut and graceful stop discipline for large MLX models
summary: ExitTimeOut zero is interpreted as infinity, and the man page says it should not be used because it can stall system shutdown forever.

facts.text: ExitTimeOut zero is interpreted as infinity, and the man page says it should not be used because it can stall system shutdown forever.
A plist for a 400 GB-class MLX server should set ExitTimeOut explicitly rather than rely on any default.
CONTRADICTS launchd-service-setup-for-local-llm-servers.md line 53 (ExitTimeOut defaults to 20 s): launchd.plist(5) says only that the default value is system-defined.

CONTRADICTS omlx-fatal-teardown-watchdog-and-wired-memory-st.md ("default 5 s launchd kill window"): the man page names no 5 s default; the figure is the issue reporter's observation, not a documented value.
